newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian stocks seen mixed, golds to suffer.
newsitem.headline: Australian stocks seen mixed, golds to suffer.

text.p: *Gold stocks seen weaker after big price fall. "I think you
will see a repeat of Thursday with miners down and industrials
up. The golds are going to get a hiding," said a Sydney dealer.
*Wall Street soars to record highs as economic data offered further evidence of moderate growth and controlled inflation.
*ADRs: News Corp 19-1/2 (+1/16), BHP 29-7/8 (-1/8), WMC 25-1/4 (-5/16), National Australia Bank 73-5/8 (+1/2)
*Gold slumped to a 12 year low after news of selling by the Reserve Bank. On LME, most ended firmer but off early highs as copper spread rates eased and profit takers moved into zinc.
